title: SMB Account Executive
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are seeking an SMB Account Executive to drive commercial growth across Australia and New Zealand, focused on the small and medium law firm segment. SMB at Harvey means law firms with between 5 and 15 lawyers on staff (excluding support staff and paralegals); we estimate roughly a quarter of all lawyers globally work at SMB-sized firms. This is a founding role on a new segment for the region - a chance to leave a mark, help develop our playbook, and provide valuable feedback directly to product leadership.

You will be joining as a founding member of our Sydney team.

What you'll do

- Own and grow a territory of SMB accounts across ANZ, driving full-funnel sales activity from prospecting through to commercial negotiation and onboarding.

- Manage a high-velocity pipeline, selling annual commitments to law firm buyers with an average deal cycle of approximately 30 days.

- Sell consultatively to Partners and Managing Partners at small law firms, understanding their pain points and tailoring solutions to their priorities.

- Lead high-impact product demos and client meetings that clearly articulate Harvey's business value and technical capabilities.

- Run disciplined qualification, discovery, objection handling, and closing, applying methodologies such as MEDDIC or Challenger.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, legal, engineering, and go-to-market teams to surface client needs and inform the roadmap.

- Document learnings, iterate on messaging, and help build scalable processes to accelerate regional growth.

What we're looking for

- Approximately 1-2 years of closing experience, ideally in complex B2B SaaS sales cycles within the mid-market or enterprise segments.

- Proven success in qualification, discovery, objection handling, and closing, with the ability to build multi-threaded relationships and navigate org charts.

- Strong analytical ability and structured thinking, with clear, credible communication to senior stakeholders.

- Coachability and humility - growth-minded, open to feedback, and comfortable operating in a fast-evolving environment with limited structure.

- Genuine interest in the legal industry and a commitment to enhancing knowledge work through technology.

- Familiarity with sales practices in the ANZ region is a plus.

Additional information

- Location: Sydney, NSW (hybrid - 3 days in the Sydney office, 2 days working from home).

- Work eligibility: Must have valid Australian work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role.

What we offer

- The chance to be a founding member of our Sydney team and help build a new segment.

- A structured hybrid working arrangement.

- Enterprise-level exposure and a clear path to progress toward an Enterprise AE role.

title: Senior Engineer - Hyperscale Analytics
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

We are seeking exceptional Senior Engineer- Hyperscale Analytics to design and scale next-generation data processing and analytics platforms that power OLTP, OLAP, and large-scale distributed data systems. You will build and optimize pipelines and services that handle billions of records daily, enabling real-time transactions, analytical insights, and AI-driven decisioning.

What You’ll Do

• Transactional & Analytical Systems: Design and implement highly scalable OLTP systems for real-time workloads and OLAP systems for complex analytical queries on massive datasets

• Distributed Processing: Build, optimize, and maintain large-scale batch and streaming pipelines using frameworks such as Apache Spark, Flink, Presto/Trino, or Kafka Streams

• System Performance & Scale: Optimize systems for low-latency queries, high-throughput ingestion, and interactive analytics, ensuring seamless performance as data volumes scale to petabytes

• Data Infrastructure: Develop and integrate with modern storage and processing systems (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Cassandra, HDFS, Delta Lake, Iceberg) to support hybrid analytical/transactional workloads

• Reliability & Observability: Ensure high availability, reliability, and monitoring across large compute and storage clusters with automated failover and recovery

• Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to build unified, secure, and cost-efficient data platforms

What You’ll Bring

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion focused on data infrastructure, distributed systems, or large-scale analytics platforms

• Deep experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, or similar)

• Strong background in cloud-scale data architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - data lakes, warehouses, streaming platforms

• Proficiency in one or more of: Python, Java, Scala, or Go

• Experience with modern data warehouse/lakehouse technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift)

• Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT design, and pipeline orchestration (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

• Track record of designing for scale, reliability, and cost efficiency in production systems

Bonus Skills

• Experience with HTAP (Hybrid Transactional/Analytical Processing) systems or real-time analytics platforms

• Familiarity with data lakehouse architectures and formats like Parquet, ORC, Delta, Iceberg, Hudi

• Knowledge of containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud-native data architectures (AWS Redshift, GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse)

• Background in query engine development or contributing to open-source OLAP/OLTP frameworks

 
What you'll get

• Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares

• Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day

• Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program

• 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions

• Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch , our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient - and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role
We are looking for a Staff AI Productivity Engineer to accelerate how our engineering organization works with AI coding tools. This is a hands-on technical role focused on building infrastructure, tooling, and documentation that makes AI agents dramatically more effective across our codebase.
AI tools are evolving rapidly, and we believe the companies that invest in making agents truly productive - not just available - will have a significant advantage. You'll own this problem end-to-end: from setting up cloud development environments where agents can run autonomously, to building MCP integrations that give agents access to our internal systems, to creating the documentation and context that helps agents understand how we build software.
You’ll have the hands-on acumen to do a lot of the heavy lifting yourself and the leadership skills to drive cross-team efforts to raise the bar everywhere. This role is a companion role to our Developer Productivity role but has a distinct focus: while Dev Productivity owns the build/test/deploy pipeline, you'll own the AI-assisted development experience. An exceptional candidate could wear both hats.
Some of the problems we’ll be working on include:

•
Own the agentic development environment: Ensure agents can operate in independent cloud-based development environments, execute our full test suites, examine build results visually, etc

•
Build our tooling integrations: Build MCP server integrations that connect our agents to the systems needed to build and debug software, such as CircleCI, Slack, Datadog, Github, etc

•
Documentation and context: Own our repo-wide file and work with teams to ensure our library of agent guidance and skills is continually pushing the bar. Ensure our conventions and package structures are exposed in ways that agents can effectively use

•
Enablement: Work with our engineers to understand where agents are struggling and address root causes such as better docs, tooling access, etc. Develop tooling for non-engineers to make simple visual updates to our application

•
Serve as a “PM” for internal AI agents: Consistently keep us on the leading edge of AI productivity trends by staying abreast of what is state-of-the-art in industry and driving those improvements across Hightouch

We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. This is a senior role, but we focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $180,000 - $400,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window.

title: Freelance Senior Data Governance Analyst
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden
Voor deze opdracht zoeken we een senior Data Governance Analyst die ondersteuning biedt bij de analyse, documentatie en implementatie van data governance. De focus ligt op het verbeteren van de vindbaarheid, begrijpbaarheid en kwaliteit van data.

• Je brengt datasets, databronnen, metadata, datastromen, eigenaarschap en datakwaliteit in kaart.

• Je analyseert waar informatie ontbreekt of onduidelijk is en documenteert je bevindingen op een heldere manier.

• Je ondersteunt bij het identificeren en vastleggen van Data Owners, Data Stewards en andere betrokken rollen.

• Je verzamelt input bij verschillende stakeholders en vertaalt die naar duidelijke overzichten, definities, procesbeschrijvingen en documentatie.

• Je helpt datakwaliteitsproblemen, kwaliteitsregels en metadata-afspraken te documenteren en op te volgen.

• Je registreert en onderhoudt relevante informatie in data catalog tooling.

• Je werkt mee aan het concreet toepasbaar maken en implementeren van bestaande en nieuwe data governance-afspraken binnen data- en businessprocessen.

📝 Jouw profiel

• Je hebt ervaring met data-analyse, data governance, metadata management of data quality.

• Je bent sterk in het verzamelen, analyseren en structureren van informatie.

• Je vertaalt complexe informatie vlot naar duidelijke en bruikbare documentatie.

• Je hebt affiniteit met data, moderne dataplatformen en AI-omgevingen.

• Je communiceert vlot met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.

• Je pakt change pragmatisch aan en weet anderen mee te krijgen in nieuwe afspraken.

• Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en consistent.

• Ervaring met data catalog tooling is een plus.

• Kennis van data governance-principes en relevante regelgeving, zoals GDPR, is een plus.

• Ervaring binnen een data- of AI-omgeving is een plus.

💼 Aanbod
Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

title: Corporate Complex Business Travel Sales Manager
description:
Omni Corporate Offices Omni Hotels and Resorts creates genuine, authentic guest experiences at over 50 distinctive luxury hotels and resorts in leading business gateways and leisure destinations across North America. Omni Hotels is known for its exemplary culture, authenticity to the markets in which we operate, innovation and exceptional service. Our commitment to career development has created tenure and loyalty that enables us to perpetuate our family atmosphere.
Overview:
The Complex Business Travel Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth from established and new business travel accounts across assigned hotel properties. This role manages contracted transient business, identifies and activates new revenue opportunities, and increases market share within each hotel’s competitive set. CBTSM serves as a strategic connector between sales, hotel leadership, and operations to ensure top corporate clients receive a seamless, high-quality experience.

• Remote candidates considered for this role must reside in the Dallas market
Responsibilities:

• Grow revenue from established corporate business travel accounts while identifying and securing new business travel opportunities for assigned hotels.

• Research, analyze, and activate market-specific sales strategies to drive share penetration within each asset’s competitive set.

• Leverage local market intelligence, industry resources, and business development tools to uncover new demand sources and emerging accounts.

• Grow revenue from established corporate business travel accounts while identifying and securing new business travel opportunities for assigned hotels.

• Research, analyze, and activate market-specific sales strategies to drive share penetration within each asset’s competitive set.

• Leverage local market intelligence, industry resources, and business development tools to uncover new demand sources and emerging accounts.

• Partner with Global Account Directors to develop and execute local market strategies for global accounts, ensuring alignment with overarching account objectives while maximizing local production and share growth at assigned hotels.

• Collaborate closely with Group, Catering, Leisure, and Other Sales Teams to identify cross-selling opportunities between business travel, group, and catering segments.

• Act as a key liaison between Sales and Hotel Operations, including Front Office, Guest Services, and Loyalty teams.

• Communicate top client needs, preferences, production expectations, and service requirements to hotel leadership and operating teams.

• Support execution of account-specific service strategies to drive satisfaction, retention, and loyalty.

• Provide regular updates, insights, and performance reporting to stakeholders.

Qualifications:

• Proven experience in business travel, corporate transient, or hotel sales, preferably in a multi-property or complex environment.

• Strong knowledge of corporate RFP processes, contracting, and rate strategy.

• Ability to analyze market data, competitive sets, and account performance to drive strategic decisions.

• Demonstrated success in relationship management, negotiation, and revenue growth.

• Strong collaboration skills with the ability to influence across sales disciplines and hotel operations.

• Willingness to travel within region and beyond as needed (up to 30%)

• 3+ years of hotel sales experience

title: Účetní Analytik/čka (Accountant/RTR)
description:
Do našeho Group Finance Centre hledáme GL / RTR Accountant, který se bude starat o účetní agendu v rámci procesu Record to Report pro Rohlik Group a související společnosti.
Čeká tě práce na měsíčních závěrkách, účetních zápisech a odsouhlasování účtů napříč více entitami. Zároveň hledáme někoho, kdo nechce jen mechanicky zpracovávat účetnictví, ale všímá si, kde můžeme procesy dělat jednodušeji, rychleji a efektivněji.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Dostaneš se k účetnictví napříč více společnostmi Rohlik Group, ne jen k jedné lokální entitě.

- Budeš součástí celého RTR procesu a získáš širší zkušenost s účetními závěrkami a reportingovým cyklem.

- Vedle každodenní účetní agendy se zapojíš také do zlepšování a nastavování procesů.

- Budeš spolupracovat s kolegy napříč Finance týmy a postupně si budovat hlubší znalost fungování Group Finance.

- Je to dobrá příležitost pro někoho, kdo už má první účetní zkušenosti a chce se dál profesně posouvat.

Co tě u nás čeká

- Zodpovědnost za svěřenou část procesu měsíční účetní závěrky

- Zpracování pravidelných účetních zápisů (Journal Vouchers)

- Práce podle uzávěrkového kalendáře napříč více entitami

- Kontrola včasnosti a kvality odsouhlasení účtů

- Samostatné řešení běžných a opakujících se účetních úkolů

- Řešení známých účetních problémů ve spolupráci s Group Accounting Managerem

- Spolupráce s dalšími Finance týmy napříč skupinou

- Zapojení do nastavování KPI a performance managementu

- Hledání příležitostí ke zjednodušení, standardizaci a zvýšení efektivity RTR procesů

Co od tebe očekáváme

- 1-2 roky praktických zkušeností v oblasti českého účetnictví nebo financí

- Dobrou znalost základních účetních principů

- Studium nebo dokončené vzdělání v oblasti Business Administration, účetnictví, financí nebo podobném oboru

- Zkušenost nebo zájem o zlepšování účetních procesů

- Pečlivost, dobrou organizaci práce a schopnost dodržovat termíny

- Dobré komunikační schopnosti a chuť spolupracovat s kolegy napříč týmy

- Češtinu plynně (nutnost) a Angličtinu na pokročilé úrovni, kterou zvládneš používat každý den v psané i mluvené komunikaci

-

Co z toho budeš mít

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš atraktivní fixní mzdu - bez bonusových her a politiky. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport a wellbeing - Zůstaneš v pohybu díky firemním sportovním výzvám nebo dotované Multisport kartě.

- Tým, který drží při sobě - Budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem se podporují a společně slaví úspěchy.

- Zní to jako ty? - Jsi člověk, který bere věci do vlastních rukou, jedná rychle a dotahuje věci do konce?

- Tak pojď s námi „upéct“ něco skvělého.

- Praxi v pickování: Zkušenost s pickováním se stabilním výkony a vysokou kvalitou.

This is where security meets innovation at enterprise scale. As a security engineer, applications at WRITER, you'll be building the security foundations that protect the AI systems powering some of the world's most recognizable brands. a bit about you

About the role
As Director, Image Analysis & Radiopharmaceutical Therapy, you will provide integrated scientific and management leadership across imaging-driven clinical trials, providing scientific guidance on development of modelling, analysis design, results interpretation and dosimetry techniques to clinical trials. You are accountable for both the scientific integrity and end-to-end delivery of image analysis data supporting multi-center trials, including Radiopharmaceutical Therapy (RPT) and advanced imaging modalities such as PET/SPECT and MRI. This role combines scientific leadership and oversight with functional and people management responsibility to ensure consistent, high-quality data delivery, robust methodology, and operational excellence aligned with business objectives and regulatory expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Scientific Leadership Responsibilities

• Act as the functional scientific authority for imaging and quantitative analysis methodologies, particularly in Radiopharmaceutical Therapy.

• Act as the senior external scientific interface for sponsors and key stakeholders, providing critical scientific input and guidance for interactions with sponsors regarding analysis design and results interpretation.

• Provide scientific leadership and authoritative scientific judgement on complex, high-risk clinical trials utilizing medical imaging and clinical data.

• Author, review, and approve scientific documentation including imaging guidelines, charters, and results summaries.

• Oversee the development and oversight of quantitative image analysis and dosimetry workflows.

• Ensure scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and methodological consistency across Image Analysis studies.

Image Analysis Delivery & Operational Excellence

• Hold ultimate accountability for holistic image analysis data delivery across relevant programs and portfolios.

• Define and enforce standards, SOPs, quality frameworks, and delivery models for Image Analysis within the organisation.

• Set delivery performance expectations and monitor outcomes through leading senior‑level functional governance forums.

• Resolve escalated scientific, quality, or delivery risks.

• Partner cross‑functionally to ensure scalable, compliant delivery models align to agreed business priorities.

• ​Provide coaching and support to team for client interactions, including capabilities presentations, scientific & medical services support, and data presentation/interpretation.

• Ensure timely, consistent, and high-quality data outputs.

People & Functional Leadership

title: Trade Support Senior - Remoto - Com Inglês
description:
SOBRE A CAPCO 

A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 40 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

 

A equipe Offshore de Trade Support é responsável pela execução de processos ponta a ponta (end-to-end) de suporte a operações para produtos de Bonds (títulos de dívida) e Term Loans (empréstimos a prazo) nos mercados dos Estados Unidos e EMEA (Europa, Oriente Médio e África) .

A equipe oferece suporte às funções de Middle Office e Back Office onshore , realizando atividades como registro das operações ( trade booking ), confirmação, preparação para liquidação ( settlement ) e atividades pós-liquidação, de acordo com procedimentos documentados, acordos de nível de serviço ( SLAs ) e padrões internos de controle.

As atividades de liquidação são realizadas por meio das principais infraestruturas de clearing e settlement do mercado, incluindo DTC, FED, Euroclear, CEDEL e ClearPar (para Term Loans).

A equipe offshore desempenha um papel fundamental para garantir a execução correta das operações do dia a dia, além de identificar e escalar exceções, riscos e violações para as equipes onshore de Trade Support e liderança de Operações dentro dos prazos adequados.

A equipe também é responsável por atividades específicas de pós-liquidação, incluindo investigação de operações que não foram liquidadas ( failed trades ), processamento de claims e conciliação de confirmações, com foco na redução do risco de liquidação e no aumento das taxas de processamento automatizado ( Straight-Through Processing - STP ).

Descrição da Vaga

• Executar os processos de Trade Support atribuídos de acordo com os procedimentos aprovados, frameworks de controle e SLAs estabelecidos no modelo operacional offshore.

• Realizar o registro ( trade booking ), confirmação e preparação para liquidação de operações com Bonds e Term Loans , utilizando infraestruturas como DTC, Euroclear, FED e ClearPar .

• Garantir que as operações sejam registradas de forma correta, completa e dentro dos prazos acordados nos sistemas relevantes.

• Confirmar as operações com as contrapartes de acordo com os padrões de mercado e as diretrizes internas.

• Em TD+0 / TD+1 , garantir que as operações estejam conciliadas ( matched ), com os recursos financeiros necessários ( funded ) e prontas para liquidação na data de valor.

• Monitorar o status das liquidações e identificar proativamente possíveis problemas, escalando riscos e atrasos para as equipes onshore quando necessário.

• Investigar e solucionar divergências nas operações ( trade breaks ), escalando exceções não resolvidas para os stakeholders apropriados.

• Apoiar a gestão de operações não liquidadas ( failed trades ) e o processamento de claims, garantindo acompanhamento dentro dos prazos e manutenção adequada dos registros.

• Realizar o registro e a liquidação de operações de Repo (Repurchase Agreement) .

• Executar controles diários, reconciliações e validações de checklists para garantir a conformidade com os requisitos internos de controle.

• Monitorar relatórios de exceções dos sistemas, filas de erros e estações/filas de tarefas, garantindo correção ou escalonamento dentro dos prazos adequados.

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Systems Product Management team, you will build the intelligence layer behind Everpure's FlashArray and FlashBlade roadmap decisions. Our platforms generate an extraordinary volume of signal-fleet telemetry from tens of thousands of deployed systems alongside commercial, support, and cost data. Working directly with product managers across the portfolio, you will translate complex, cross-system questions into engineering solutions-leveraging applied AI and fleet-scale data engineering to build production systems that directly shape the hardware we ship.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Own Engagements End-to-End : Partner directly with product managers to scope ambiguous business questions and carry them from discovery through to a solution running in production.

•
Design and Build the Platform : Deliver end-to-end capabilities, spanning data and orchestration layers through to the interfaces product managers actively use.

•
Build for Trust : Maintain high engineering standards so product managers can confidently stake critical roadmap decisions on system output.

•
Turn One-Offs into Capability : Convert bespoke, hard-won analyses into durable platform capabilities that continuously expand self-service intelligence.

•
Strengthen the Data Foundation : Identify gaps where existing data cannot answer strategic questions, partnering with data owners across the organization to close them.

WHAT YOU BRING

•
Production Engineering Craft : Strong, hands-on Python experience designing, building, and operating software in production-including HTTP APIs, relational schema design and migrations, containerized cloud deployments, version control, CI/CD, testing discipline, and frontend capability to build usable interfaces.

•
Data Judgment at Scale : Advanced SQL proficiency with large analytical datasets (e.g., Snowflake) and the business acumen to evaluate data integrity, understanding which strategic questions data can accurately answer.

•
Applied AI Experience : Proven experience shipping LLM-backed or agentic systems to real users, combined with rigorous evaluation practices that maintain system integrity as it evolves.

•
Communication and Influence : Ability to collaborate with non-technical stakeholders to define tractable engineering problems, exercise technical judgment, and communicate system readiness with credibility.

•
Location : We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: Mission Engineer II - Saratoga
locationText: New York, New York, United States
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable. As a Mission Engineer II, you'll work directly alongside public safety agencies to turn real operational challenges into working technical solutions.

You'll spend time with the people doing the work, understand how the agency operates, identify problems worth solving, and use Axon tools, AI, automation, data, and the broader Axon ecosystem to build against them. 

Building is the core of the role, but customer needs come first. Because you're embedded with the agency, you'll also become a go-to technical resource who understands their Axon environment and helps them navigate critical needs when they arise. You may help quarterback an upcoming deployment, coordinate a complex technical issue, or connect the right Axon teams around an agency priority.

You won't replace Support, Deployment, Product, or other teams. You'll bring technical continuity, help connect the dots, and use what you learn to identify the next opportunity to build something better. Mission Engineers don't measure success by activity. They measure it by what gets built, what gets used, and what changes because of it.

What You’ll Do

Location: On Site with travel
Reports To: Manager or Senior Manager of Mission Engineering

Discover the Mission

• Embed with assigned agencies to understand their mission, people, workflows, systems, and priorities.

• Develop broad knowledge of the Axon ecosystem and deeper expertise in the products deployed at your agency.

• Work with frontline users, technical teams, and agency leadership to uncover operational friction.

• Translate customer problems into clear technical requirements and measurable success criteria.

• Identify opportunities for AI, automation, data, and Axon capabilities to improve how the agency operates.

• Understand what the customer needs-not simply what they initially ask for.

Build With the Platform

• Build applications, dashboards, workflows, automations, and using Axon products and other approved Axon tools.

• Apply foundational software engineering concepts including APIs, data structures, scripting, testing, debugging, and version control.

• Use AI and AI-assisted development tools responsibly within Axon's approved development and security environment.

• Configure and extend capabilities across Axon's technology ecosystem.

• Understand when you can solve the problem yourself and when deeper Product or Engineering partnership is required.

• Build with Axon-not around it.

Transform Builds Into Outcomes

• Move solutions from discovery into real customer use.

• Test and iterate alongside the people who will actually use what you build.

• Drive adoption and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Continue improving solutions until they create sustained operational value.

• Document successful solutions so they can be maintained, improved, and reused.

Be the Agency's Go-To Technical Resource

• Maintain a consistent onsite presence and deep understanding of the agency's Axon environment.

• Lean into critical customer needs when your technical context or involvement can materially improve the outcome.

• Help quarterback technical alignment around important deployments without replacing the teams responsible for deployment execution.

• Serve as a liaison when complex technical issues require coordination

title: Nurse Practitioner - California (CA) License (Remote, Half-Time)
description:
Nurse Practitioner
Integrated Women’s Care (IWC) Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Compensation: $55 - $75 / hour, based on geographic location
Reports To: Nurse Practitioner Manager
Work Location: Remote - work must be completed within the United States
Schedule: Between 7:00 am - 7:00 pm, patient local timezone
You built your career caring for women at a time when the healthcare system largely ignored them. You know HRT, you understand the complexity of perimenopause, and you’ve spent years earning the clinical instincts it takes to actually get this right. Now you want to do it at scale - for more patients, with fewer barriers, and in a practice model that matches how you already think and work.
That’s what Midi is. A fully virtual, fast-paced clinical environment built specifically around women’s midlife health - and designed for NPs who are ready to practice at their best.
THE ROLE
You’ll carry a full patient panel, managing perimenopause, menopause, weight, sexual health, mood, and sleep - all virtually. This is ongoing, relationship-based care, which means your patients come back to you - visit after visit, over months and years. You’ll prescribe and independently manage HRT (estrogen, progesterone, testosterone), evaluate patients for pharmacologic weight management including GLP-1 therapies, and make autonomous clinical decisions every day.
It’s a high-volume environment. Documentation, follow-through, and productivity benchmarks are part of the job - and the NPs who thrive here don’t fight that reality, they’re built for it. If you’re the kind of clinician who runs efficient visits without sacrificing warmth, closes every loop without being reminded, and moves comfortably between patients and platforms, you’ll feel at home here.

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. Serious fun.
What the job looks like

• Build and maintain end-to-end pipelines in the Azure stack, ingesting source data into the Data Lake and Azure SQL, orchestrated with Azure Data Factory.

• Develop the data warehouse layers from raw staging through the Data Vault and Business Vault into the dimensional Data Mart, primarily in T-SQL.

• Write and optimise stored procedures for transformation and loading (full, incremental and delete loads), including watermark-driven incremental processing.

• Model data correctly, designing hubs, links and satellites in the vault, and conformed facts and dimensions in the mart.

• Investigate and understand source systems (e.g. terminal operating and maintenance systems) so the model reflects what the data really means, not just its shape.

• Deliver in Power BI, building datasets/semantic models and reports yourself, not just opening someone else’s dashboard.

• Wear the analyst hat, profiling new datasets, answering data questions directly, and validating that numbers reconcile before they reach the business.

• You'll work in with T-SQL · Azure (Data Factory, Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure SQL) · Power BI · Git - plus Data Vault and dimensional modelling.

Requirements
What you bring

• ~5+ years hands-on , across data engineering and database development. We weight depth and range over the exact number, but this isn't a junior seat; you've owned real warehouse work, not just touched it.

• Real relational-database depth: you model in 3NF, read an execution plan, tune a slow query, and work confidently in the Data Vault layer beneath the mart, not just the semantic layer on top.

• Excellent T-SQL: especially stored procedures for transformation and loading.

• Hands-on Azure data engineering: you've built end-to-end pipelines with ADF, Data Lake Gen2 and Azure SQL.

• You build in Power BI, not just consume it: datasets/semantic models, relationships, DAX, reports.

• A reliability habit: data quality validated and monitored as part of the work, Git as a default, and the confidence to trace a broken pipeline/proc/DB project to root cause and fix it calmly.

• Communication: fully comfortable in English to collaborate with clients and a remote team.

description:
Runpod is the AI Developer Cloud. More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests. We closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. We're at an inflection point for AI infrastructure, and we're building the platform the next generation of developers will depend on. Learn more in our CEO's funding announcement: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers.

We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, move fast, and ship work that more than a million developers rely on every day. We're looking for people who care deeply, build with urgency, and want to matter at scale.

As Runpod continues to revolutionize the GPU cloud computing landscape, we are seeking a systems-focused Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineer. This critical position is instrumental in safeguarding our bare-metal and virtualized environments, ensuring the absolute security, multi tenant isolation, and integrity of our underlying GPU cloud infrastructure.

The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of Linux systems, kernel internals, hypervisors, and containerization. You will focus on the lowest levels of our stack-preventing tenant breakouts, securing GPU hardware allocations, and building resilient infrastructure to support AI and machine learning workloads.

Runpod is seeking an innovative security engineer who thrives at the systems layer. You will operate with an Attacker's Mindset, actively hunting for ways to break container and virtualization boundaries, and then writing the low-level code to patch them.

Responsibilities:

- Systems Isolation: Design and implement robust workload and network isolation architectures for RunPod's multitenant GPU bare-metal and virtualized environments.

- Kernel & Container Security: Harden Linux kernel configurations, container runtimes (e.g., Docker, containerd), and orchestration layers (e.g., Kubernetes) against breakouts and privilege escalation.

- Infrastructure Threat Modeling: Conduct deep-dive security assessments and penetration testing specifically targeting our hypervisor, network stack, and hardware interfaces.

- Active Defense: Write code (primarily C, Go, or Rust) to implement custom security controls, telemetry, and fixes at the OS and infrastructure level.

- Hardware Security: Evaluate and mitigate security considerations specific to GPU architecture, PCIe pass-through, and shared memory spaces.

- Incident Response: Serve as the technical escalation point for infrastructure-level security incidents, developing forensic capabilities for ephemeral container environments.

Required Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience in infrastructure or systems-level security engineering.

- Extensive knowledge of Linux kernel internals (cgroups, namespaces, eBPF, SELinux/AppArmor).

- Deep understanding of virtualization technologies (KVM, QEMU) and workload/network isolation techniques in multitenant environments.

- Strong systems-level programming skills in C, Go, Rust, or Python.

- Familiarity with GPU architecture and hardware-level security considerations.

- Experience in securing bare-metal cloud infrastructure and mitigating lower-level CVEs.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Contributions to open-source systems security projects or virtualization research.

- Experience writing or deploying eBPF-based security tooling.

- Deep knowledge of low-level networking protocols and virtualized network security.

title: Sr IT Director II

The Senior IT Director II, Operations Delivery & Reliability is a senior leadership role accountable for the platforms on which the enterprise builds, hosts, and runs software - and for the controls, lifecycle, and quality disciplines that keep the technology estate reliable, compliant, and current. This Level II Senior Director leads other director- and senior-manager-level leaders across application hosting and platform engineering, integration, DevOps and automation, observability, and the enterprise service-management, configuration, asset, lifecycle, and technology-controls functions.
This role pairs a build-and-run platform mandate with an independent stewardship mandate: enabling development teams to deliver software quickly and safely, while governing the change, incident, configuration, compliance, and lifecycle disciplines that protect service quality across every tower. The successful candidate is equally comfortable commanding a Sev-1 major-incident bridge, setting the roadmap for the enterprise ITSM and observability platforms, and briefing executive leadership on reliability, technical-debt, and license-compliance posture.

Tower 4 - Application & Developer Platforms (build, host, and run software)

• Curiosity about businesses and how they operate.

• Self-motivation in a remote working environment.

• Comfort working towards measurable activity and sales targets.

• Professional judgement and honesty about what has and has not happened in the sales process.

title: Program Associate

About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities - and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

The Role
Kasa is seeking a Program Associate to help operationalize the projects that keep our hospitality operations running well and improving. You're a generalist at heart, someone who loves trying new things and learning on the fly, and this role rewards exactly that: you'll flex across a wide range of work, from overhauling an SOP, to project managing a launch alongside the launch team, to helping scope product and tooling improvements with the teams who build them.
Change management is at the center of this role. Most of what you deliver will change how a team already works. You'll own the rollout, the adoption, and the follow-through. You'll partner closely with program leads, portfolio teams, and Product. That means reading detailed product specs and user guides, then pulling out what actually matters for each operational role. A Support Specialist and a Housekeeping lead need different things from the same launch, so the guide you write for each should show the moment they'd reach for the feature and what they'd do with it. You'll also keep the details from slipping between teams.
You're organized and proactive in your communication. You write updates even when there isn't a major update, because you know stakeholders need to understand where the work stands, where it's headed, and what decisions have already been made. You document clearly, communicate consistently, and use data to support your recommendations and track progress.
We're looking for someone who is genuinely data-forward, comfortable looking honestly at their own projects and asking what worked, what didn't, and what to do differently next time. Though this role is remote, occasional travel to Kasa Portfolio Properties will be necessary for implementing solutions, testing changes, and testing onsite.
About the Team
This role is in our Hospitality Programs department, with close ties to teams across Kasa . While the Hospitality Programs team has a broad set of backgrounds in hospitality, real estate, technology, and beyond, everyone joined Kasa because they're passionate about ensuring our guests, property partners, and neighbors receive reliable and consistent high-quality service during each interaction.

• Customer Service

• Communicate through words and action that you are committed to helping guests resolve their housing problems; ensure to inquire about the guest’s needs and preferences.

• Promote other CONAM properties when the property that the prospect is interested in cannot accommodate the prospect’s housing needs.

• Comply with CONAM’s professional appearance standards and dress code.

• Administrative

• Document all interactions with prospects and the property leasing team using the dedicated platforms for follow-up purposes. Platforms include but are not limited to the CONAM Lead Tracking System, Email Blast Tool, Outlook, Teams, and the CONAM Property Management Software.

• Comply with all Fair Housing Regulations and CONAM best practices when engaging with prospects and the property teams.

• All other duties as assigned.

title: Staff Design Engineer
description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at .

About the role
At Mixpanel , we believe design excellence is a competitive moat. In a world where AI makes it easier than ever to ship, we believe the quality of the experience - how it feels, how it builds trust, how it handles complexity with grace - that separates good products from great ones.
As a Staff Design Engineer at Mixpanel , you'll sit within the design organization and lead the transformation of our design system from a component library into something far more important: the infrastructure that powers how we design, build, and ship in an AI-native world. You'll encode our craft, standards, and vision directly into the systems, tools, and workflows that every designer, engineer, and AI agent in our org builds on.
This isn't a maintenance or systems stewardship role. It's a transformative one. You'll work at the frontier of what design and engineering collaboration looks like when AI writes most of the code, agents prototype from intent, and the design system is less a library and more a living foundation for everything we ship.
You'll be the designer who ships production code. The engineer who holds an uncompromising craft bar. The person who sees the future of how Mixpanel will look and behave in an AI-native world, and builds the infrastructure to make it real.
What you'll do
Build the infrastructure for an AI-native design practice
Translate Mixpanel 's design standards, principles, and taste into systems that live in the code. Build a token system, component library, documentation, and guidelines that AI agents, AI coding tools, and AI prototyping workflows can reliably build on. Evolve our design system to be foundational infrastructure for AI-assisted workflows.
Shape how Mixpanel looks and behaves in an AI-native world
Sit within the product design team and collaborate on reimagining Mixpanel for a world where interfaces are conversational, agentic, and adaptive. You have the rare combination of deep design sensibility and production engineering skills, and you’ll use both to help bring our AI product vision to life with craft and coherence that generic AI outputs can't match.
Own the bridge between design and code
Build systems that connect design to code and keep the two in sync. Define what "shippable" looks like as AI writes more of the code. Work directly in the codebase. Ship PRs that improve the product. Make design a force multiplier for engineering, not a bottleneck.
Stand up prototyping and AI tooling infrastructure
Build the workflows, tools, and infrastructure that let designers and PMs prototype at high fidelity, with working code, real components, and interactive states, without waiting on engineering. Identify the places where design and engineering lose time, intent, or quality in the handoff, and build AI-powered workflows that close those gaps.
Set and model the craft bar
Establish what great looks like - not through documentation alone, but through the quality of what you ship. Enable designers to work more code-adjacent and engineers to build with better components. Stay ahead of how AI is changing EPD workflows and bring that change into the org responsibly.
What success looks like

• The design system is a reliable foundation that AI tools and agents build on, not an obstacle they work around

• Design and code are in sync; the gap between what's designed and what ships is closed

• Designers can prototype at high fidelity without waiting on engineering

• Engineers spend less time on UI polish and rework, more time on features

• The Mixpanel product feels unmistakably itself - cohesive, expressive, and craft-forward - as it evolves
